description: Search Ozon, browse a category, fetch product details, inspect a seller, or collect reviews and buyer questions for RU, BY, or KZ.

categoryUrls.description: Full Ozon category/brand URLs or bare slugs, e.g. `https://www.ozon.ru/category/smartfony-15502/` or `smartfony-15502`.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs or slugs (mode=byCategory)

inStockOnly.description: Only keep products that are currently available.
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

includeOtherSellers.description: Add the buybox list of other sellers for each product.
includeOtherSellers.title: Include competing seller offers

includeProductDetails.description: For search and category rows, also fetch the product page for description, full specifications, gallery, and variants.
includeProductDetails.title: Enrich listing rows with full details

includeQuestions.description: Also emit buyer questions and their answers for each product.
includeQuestions.title: Include buyer questions (mode=reviews)

includeSellerDetails.description: Add the seller's legal name, registration number, address, and confirmed brands to product rows.
includeSellerDetails.title: Include seller legal details

includeSellerProducts.description: Emit the seller's catalog products as product rows in addition to the seller profile.
includeSellerProducts.title: Include seller catalog products (mode=seller)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. In seller mode this includes the seller profile row.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxPrice.description: Drop products pricier than this amount in the selected storefront currency.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: How many review rows to collect for each product. Set 0 to collect only question rows.
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Maximum reviews per product (mode=reviews)

minPrice.description: Drop products cheaper than this amount in the selected storefront currency.
minPrice.title: Minimum price

minRating.description: Drop products rated below this value on the 0-5 scale.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

enumTitles: Fetch full product details by URL or SKU
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: Full Ozon product URLs, short `ozon.ru/t/...` links, or bare numeric SKU/product IDs.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or SKUs (mode=productDetails or reviews)

searchQueries.description: One or more keywords, e.g. `iphone`, `телевизор`, `кофемашина`. Each query is collected in order.
searchQueries.title: Search queries (mode=search)

sellerUrls.description: Ozon seller storefront URLs, slugs, or numeric seller IDs, e.g. `https://www.ozon.ru/seller/dubaidutyfree/`.
sellerUrls.title: Seller URLs or IDs (mode=seller)

sortBy.description: Result ordering for search, category, and seller catalog listings.
sortBy.title: Sort order

storefront.description: Which Ozon market to read. Prices use the local currency: RUB for Russia, BYN for Belarus, KZT for Kazakhstan.
storefront.title: Storefront
